_note: Approved, reusable text. The model never writes these; code selects them by ID. Sample copy for this reference repo; production copy is approved by a clinical reviewer.

DISC-001.title: I'm an AI companion
DISC-001.text: I'm an AI companion, not a person. I can help with reminders and notes. I can't give medical advice.

DISC-002.text: I can remind you, keep notes, and contact your caregiver. Decisions about your medicine are for your prescriber.

FB-001.text: I couldn't answer that just now. A person will follow up.

FB-002.text: I couldn't show that safely. A person will follow up.

LM-001.text: That's outside what I can help with. Would you like me to ask your caregiver?

CL-001.text: I'm here whenever you need me.
